hero.title: Give a Renata França treatment
hero.text: A moment of lightness to offer your loved ones. The gift voucher is sent to you as a PDF as soon as you pay, ready to print or forward. It is valid for one year, at the Lyon 1 or Saint-Cyr-au-Mont-d'Or practice.

card.title: Gift vouchers
card.comingSoon: Online payment will be available soon.

items.title: Choose the treatment
items.text: Select the treatment you want to give from the list, then pay online by card, securely.

items.title: Receive the gift voucher
items.text: The PDF voucher is emailed to you as soon as you pay, with a unique code. You can print it or forward it.

items.title: Your loved one books an appointment
items.text: On Doctolib, by choosing “Bon cadeau” (gift voucher) as the reason for the appointment. The treatment is already paid for.

conditions.title: Terms
items: Valid for one year from the date of purchase.
Can be used at the Lyon 1 or Saint-Cyr-au-Mont-d'Or practice.
Non-refundable and cannot be exchanged for cash.
A package is for one and the same person.
During pregnancy, drainage requires a prescription.
The treatment is not possible in case of fever or infection, phlebitis, kidney or heart failure, or an open wound. For Miracle Face, wait 8 days after a facial injection.
If in doubt, contact me before giving the treatment.
